title: Schooner Charley

services.name: The Sails
services.desc: Head out from Loon’s Foot Landing and hoist the sails for a 2 ½ hour excursion. The current conditions will determine the route; either we’ll set a course for the Big Lake or stay within the protected waters of the Duluth/Superior Harbor. Feel free to bring beverages and snacks with you, but we do ask that you leave your pets at home. Passenger Minimum: We have a required minimum of 3 passengers to sail. If we don’t meet that minimum requirement and your party of 2 or fewer still wants to sail we will accommodate that for an additional fee to bring your total to $255 plus tax and booking fees. blurb: Come sail with us and experience Duluth, MN and Superior, WI from the water aboard a 60 foot steel schooner! Depending on the weather we’ll either take to the big lake or sail down the harbor. We currently sail on Fridays and Saturdays out of Loon’s Foot Marine in Superior, WI. It’s a great location to either sail out the Wisconsin entry or sail up the harbor to Duluth.
